select t1.*, t2.pen_name, t3.book_name from ai_creation_plan t1 left join author t2 on t1.author_id = t2.id left join book t3 on t1.book_id = t3.id
and (t2.pen_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t3.book_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and t1.stage = #{stage}
order by t1.update_time desc

select t1.*, t2.pen_name from ai_author_pref t1 left join author t2 on t1.author_id = t2.id
and t2.pen_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by t1.update_time desc
